gloss: out of the question; beyond discussion; absurd

definitions.gloss: out of the question; beyond discussion; absurd
definitions.explanation: So unreasonable or unacceptable that it is not even worth discussing or considering.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{論外|ろんがい}だ。
examples.english: Such a demand is out of the question.

examples.japanese: ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧せず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑|いど}む→挑む：12708_idomu⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧{論外|ろんがい}だ。
examples.english: Taking it on without any preparation is absurd.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無視|むし}して→無視する：17288_mushisuru⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{優先|ゆうせん}→優先：15243_yuusen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧、{論外|ろんがい}な⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧だ。
examples.english: Prioritizing profit while ignoring safety is an utterly unacceptable way of thinking.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧ (discussion, argument) + ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside) — literally "outside discussion." Used to dismiss something as not even worth debating. Functions as a noun and as a na-adjective ({論外|ろんがい}な).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {論外|ろんがい}だ: is out of the question
- {論外|ろんがい}な⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: an absurd proposition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{問題外|もんだいがい}→問題外：29304_mondaigai⟧: out of the question — nearly synonymous, equally dismissive
- ⟦{言語道断|ごんごどうだん}→言語道断：06145_gongodoudan⟧: outrageous; unspeakable — stronger, conveys moral outrage as well
